title: Email/query collapseThreads=true: negative position clamped to 0, not treated as relative-to-end
description: email.rs:187: let start = position.max(0) as usize; — negative positions are silently converted to 0. RFC 8620 §5.5 says negative position means 'count from the end of the result set'. The non-collapseThreads path delegates the raw position value to the backend (line 202), so the two paths behave differently for negative positions. A client using negative position with collapseThreads=true gets position 0 instead of the intended tail position. Fix: apply the same RFC 8620 negative-position semantics as Mailbox/query does (mailbox.rs:213-218).
